newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends weaker after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends weaker after choppy session.

text.p: COMEX copper settled weaker after a choppy session with the market testing the lows several times amid further weakness in the London backwardation.
Some of the jittery tone in the market also stemmed from persistent talk throughout the day of a huge hike of 15,000 to 25,000 tonnes in LME stocks on Friday.
"The backwardation should attract metal and that's what it is doing," a broker said.
The backwardation, or cash to three months premium on LME, contracted further Thursday to $202/$212 by close of COMEX trading, well down from the week's peak of about $345.
"The billion dollar question is whether the backwardation is going to disappear in two weeks and we go down to 85 or 90 cents, or not," the broker added.
March COMEX settled 1.30 cents weaker at 101.20 cents per pound, traded 102.70 to 100.40 cents. Volume was estimated at 10,000 lots compared to Wednesday's heavy 18,271 lots.
Although the overal backwardation has shrunk, the very nearby dates are still tight until mid-February and expected to provide some continuing support, traders said.
